title: Downer Graduate Engineering Program 2027
abstract: Start your engineering journey with one of Australia's leading infrastructure providers and grow through real project experience.
bullets: Mentoring from experienced engineers and industry leaders
content_text:
Start your engineering journey with one of Australia's leading infrastructure providers and grow through real project experience.
At Downer Energy & Utilities, we are looking for motivated and ambitious Graduate Engineers to join our team and contribute to delivering critical infrastructure projects across Australia and New Zealand.
As a Graduate Engineer, you will participate in a structured graduate program, with the possibility of rotating across various business functions and project environments. You will gain valuable hands on experience supporting operational, financial, programming and administrative activities while working alongside experienced industry professionals.
This role offers the opportunity to build your technical capability, develop commercial awareness and strengthen stakeholder engagement skills while contributing to projects that power and connect communities. Flexibility and mobility are essential, as project based work may require travel and relocation throughout Australia and/ or New Zealand. 
What We're Looking For
- Degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Civil Engineering, completed in 2025 or due for completion by the end of 2026
- Australian Citizenship or Permanent Residency
- Hold current driver's licence and availability to commence in February 2027
- A willingness to learn, an open mindset and a desire to build your professional career from the ground up
- Strong communication and relationship building skills
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
- A collaborative approach and eagerness to learn from experienced professionals
- A proactive, self motivated attitude with a commitment to ongoing development
What We Offer
At Downer, we are committed to developing our people and providing meaningful career opportunities.
You will benefit from:
- Exposure to major infrastructure and utilities projects across Australia
- Mentoring and support from experienced industry professionals
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities
- Strong focus on safety, sustainability and innovation
- A supportive and collaborative team environment
- Competitive remuneration and employee benefits
- Opportunities for long term career growth within a leading infrastructure services provider 
About Energy & Utilities
Downer Energy & Utilities delivers end to end engineering, construction, maintenance and asset management services to customers across power, gas, water, telecommunications and renewable energy sectors. Our people work on some of Australia's most significant infrastructure projects, helping to build sustainable communities and support the nation's future energy needs.
At Downer, our success is driven by our people. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, women, culturally diverse individuals and people with disabilities.
How to Apply
To apply for this exciting opportunity, please submit your application online including your resume and a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role.
We encourage applications from candidates who are passionate about building a career in the utilities and infrastructure sector and are committed to delivering safe and sustainable outcomes for our customers and communities.
Please note: Downer does not accept unsolicited resumes, fees or costs from recruitment agencies, search firms or third parties. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Downer or its employees will become the property of Downer and Downer will not be liable for any associated fees.
